steps.text: Pipes. They are buried deep underground with no end in sight.
These pipes connect the entire city. They are the veins of Londinium. It is through them that the energy is supplied to Londinium's heart, and that is where we are right now.
Never fear the darkness before your eyes. When the sun sets at night, the shadows live on in the city's veins.
When the light is taken, you trust your ears, your nose, and your remaining senses.
Listen carefully. The mechanical rumble is the flow of its blood. The gears rotate rhythmically like breathing.
Indeed, Londinium is alive. Even if we do not sit on its tall throne, it lives on as its own organism.
If you ever find yourself here again one day... no matter what may be chasing you, you needn't be afraid.
After all, you run through the body of Londinium.
Vina, you are home.
Okay, everyone. We can stop here for a while.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uh, where exactly are we?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We've been climbing down all this time... It's like we burrowed ourselves into some kind of pipeline...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The walkway's broader, but it's still sark as hell...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Waaahhh... Are you those cutthroats who would drive us to some abondoned construction site and slice our neck?
Huh...? *Cough*, you might be right about that.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who the hell are you anyway, punk? Don't think we'll just follow your every word.
Hm... to be on the safe side, let me ask you the same question.
Who are you people? Why are you trying to sneak into Londinium?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Before we answer that, you need to let our employee go.
Is our hooded friend your commander?
Sure enough. I figured out who calls the shots in battle. That said, Cautus lady, you're the one who's actually in charge, right?
Don't be so surprised. I'll admit you have a few tricks up your sleeves, but... we're locals, and we know this playbook a lot better than you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: A local... You live in Londinium, then?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Were you part of that big fight earlier?
Stop with the guesses. We haven’t worked up the mutual trust yet.
Dublinn and the Sarkaz fighting each other doesn't prove anything. Them bickering doesn't mean we should fall down on either side.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Londinium's veins.
Wh-What did you say?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We've made it inside Londinium.
How can you tell?!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: These pathways connect the city to the outside. They can get us past the Sarkaz guards and inside the city.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How long have we walked? Twenty minutes?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I reckon we're right underneath a certain key facility in Sudean right now.
Uh...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The facility isn't far from the walls. And it is a key hub. From here, you can get to many places in the city.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Rail tracks...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Just another kilometer or two ahead, and there will be a train station above us.
You know Londinium well. I suppose you used to live here?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm a local, too.
No wonder. I was about to say your hammer feels especially familiar. Feline lady... Uh, you're a Feline, right?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Whatever you are, that's what I am.
*Sigh*. I’m really gonna regret this if you guys are actually Sarkaz spies, aren’t I?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't hurt the Doctor—!

options: It's too late to regret anything.

steps.text: Huh?! W-When did you take over the drone?
Y-You're holding it in your bare hands?! I could detonate the drone bomb right now, you know?!

options: This drone isn't even finished. All it can do is fly.

steps.text: Urgh, this is bad.
When did you figure it out? When I was talking to you? Or when I led you down the underground passage?
Maybe even before that...? Hold on. You didn't... you couldn’t have figured out all the way back when I captured you? That this drone poses no threat?
And you let me drag you all the way down here?!

options: I had to get a feel of your intentions.
You think my friends here didn't know?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If I had thought for a second you were going to hurt the Doctor, my hammer would've cracked your skull before your hand could even touch the remote.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You know, you really should've picked someone dumber for your hostage, like this punk who only knows to speak with her fists. She might have fallen for your trick.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You think he could come anywhere close?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uh... so the signal jammer I brought along isn't gonna come in handy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —Mr. 'Local.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think it's about time we put an end to this charade. No more testing each other.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We may not face enemy cannon fire, but there's still a threat to the both of us out there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Haven't we proven ourselves?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've had many opportunities to take you down from the moment we met. Suppose we were actually spies sent here by the Sarkaz. We've already figured out the size of things here, so why waste any more time talking to you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The only reason that the Doctor was playing the hostage here and that we willingly followed you into this passageway is because we believe you mean no harm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: So shouldn't you put your trust in us more and tell us what your goal is?
Hm, that sounds very convincing. I mean, you could say I'm your hostage now.
Rockrock, come on out.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: D-D-Dr-Drones...? So many?! With that formation, they're aiming at us, aren't they? T-They could shoot us all full of holes!
Rockrock, stop it.
It doesn't matter if they spot you or your drones. Considering their strength, I wouldn't be able to get out alive, if we came to blows.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If you knew that, maybe you shouldn't have brought me along to play your stupid games.
Fine, you're right.
Hey, hooded friend, can you give Rock-17 back? The drone in your hand there. It's only half-done. If you break it, Rockrock is going to be livid.
Phew... Well, pleased to make your acquaintance.
I'm Feist. This is Rockrock, my partner.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We belong to the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How many places do you think there are in Londinium that our eyes cannot reach?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Countless many.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: There are thousands of old factories in the city. Roughly four-in-ten are abandoned. The remaining sixty percent are still operational.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Most of the factories that are still running are built on the sites of even older factories. The factory buildings might as well be labyrinths filled with centuries' worth of industrial waste.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As many factories as there are, there are even more slums hidden away between the factory buildings. Not even the top echelons of the city's defense force can say how many there are living in these civilian industrial and old logistics districts.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Sometimes, I even think this place isn't so different from Kazdel.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The more colorful outer shell is the main difference. That, and they buried the rotten parts deeper inside to keep the stench from suffocating the distinguished elite.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Trying to fish a group of troublemakers out of the Kazdel slums in three days is like trying to rob a group of Lateran envoys covered by the Apostolic Knights on your own. Not an easy ask.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It is still built atop the foundation that we were all born in Kazdel.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Londinium... Who dares to claim to know Londinium so well?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How long did it take us to defeat the parliamentary guard and take command of seventy percent of the city's defense forces?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Less than a week.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: How long did it take us to hang the aristocrats that took the lead in the opposition and defeat the hooligans they spent great sums to hire dozens of times, until they all finally fell in line?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: A month and a half.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Yet we are now months into our tug-of-war with the so-called rebels here in the Sudean streets and alleys.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: In just half a year, we seized nearly every borough of Londinium.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Every borough except this one.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A half-abandoned industrial district. From the south all the way to the north, it surrounds the mountains in Londinium's center and connects to the rarely-visited old logistics districts.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: 'This is where the history of Londinium begins.'

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So the history books claim.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I know that there must be at least one king, perhaps even several, who are dissatisfied with my progress.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You mentioned that they wanted to completely seal off this ward.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They are far too easily offended. As soon as command here falls into their hands, they will build a new wall between Sudean and the other wards with the bodies of the Londiniers.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: At the very least, the Regent supports you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: No, it is I who must do everything I can to support the general.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The court does not understand the general's pain... They do not understand how fragile the current balance is.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Do you know why I insisted on activating only the secondary defense cannons?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: If I activate the primary cannons right now... will the dukes out there march right inside?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Suppose we proceed to slaughter all the people of Londinium. Will that once again stir disloyalty among the nobles in the city and the soldiers who joined us, causing them to turn their swords against us and fight to the bitter end?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Suppose we completely abandon this industrial district. How much longer will the general's plans be delayed without the trains carrying materials to The Shard every day?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The lords' pride prevented them from casting their ancient skulls downward to see these foreign cities.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: In my opinion, if we are to control all of Londinium, the most difficult battle we must fight is right before our eyes.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The Sarkaz calls us the rebels. We got no complaints in that department.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: If the only way to save ourselves is by standing up against them, then even the most ordinary of Londiniers will take up arms.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you know what's happening in the other wards?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Can't be better than here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: All of us either work for the Sarkaz or die.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We've been getting bits and pieces of news from up north. From what I heard, the Sarkaz army there's much more cruel.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, does that mean Baird and the rest who stayed behind...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How am I supposed to be calm?! It's been five years! Five years! I don't even know if they're still...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We'll find them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Soon, we'll find each of them, one by one.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Okay, Vina. I trust you. No matter where they are. No matter if they're alive or...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Never mind! I won't get so gloomy in front of everyone.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ladies, as long as your friends are still alive, we should have a way to get in touch with them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You operate outside of Sudean too?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We can get anywhere in Londinium. Even outside the city.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: For each of us they take away, ten more join our ranks.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock is a born and bred Sudean girl. She's one of our most senior fighters. She knows better than the rest of us how our team grew, bit by bit.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Seeing as you're leading a team now, we might've been adding to our ranks a little too quickly.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha, who do you think led you to eleven victories, Lieutenant?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: All we did was lead people underground. How does that count as a victory?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Managing to live another day under the Sarkaz's noses, all while we get to keep operating in the dark? I'd call that a win.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's just as you saw. The Sarkaz haven't taken complete control of Sudean yet.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The terrain and flow of people here are so chaotic that if the Sarkaz really are trying to take control of every inch, then they must really have underestimated the place.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: And besides... This is where the last Londinium defense force squad fought the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Looks like they lost too.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: *Sigh*... They fought and they lost.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That battle was over quick... way too quick. Before any of us could react, the Sarkaz were already standing atop the walls.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: It's all because of the traitors! They bought out our elite squads!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Miss, were you in the military?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: No, I wasn't. I was... uh... a local, like them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Alright, a local.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know the military had its share of traitors. Plenty of them, even.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: The traitors and some of the aristocrats defected to the Sarkaz with much of the defense force.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Outside Sudean, you may still find Londinium forces patrolling the streets, but their commanding officers are all regulars at Sarkaz soirees now.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What about the last squad that fought here?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They held out to the bitter end. Each of them paid a dear, terrible price.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I don't know how many of them survived, but I think... having experienced a hopeless fight like that, even if they made it out alive, their hearts must ache whenever they look at Londinium's walls.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Don't be so alarmed. Keep your head up. Take your hand off the crossbow, and relax a little.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The residents here are used to seeing all kinds of people. They won't help us, but as long as they don't feel their lives are in danger, they won't follow Dublinn or the Sarkaz's orders.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Life under the enemy's watchful eyes... I can't imagine going through that.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Do you know how they used to think of us?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Uh, I haven't thought about it.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I never did either.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Lieutenant...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Alright, stop calling me Lieutenant. I'm Horn here. There are way too many lieutenants running around, of all different factions.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Right, Horn. Where are we going?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: To regroup with my companions first.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The Sarkaz patrol will pass by the area in five minutes. We'll split into two teams and follow the rail tracks east separately.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: After three hundred and fifty meters, you'll see an iron staircase leading up.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If you hear five metallic knocks, come on up. Three, stay put. Two, disband immediately.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You might think the abandoned factories there look familiar... Don't be surprised. It's Dublinn's stronghold.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen?
steps.text: Isn't that a little dangerous?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: With Dublinn occupying the area, the Sarkaz don't go there often.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Want to try your hand at hide-and-seek? You're welcome to join in on the fun.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: So are you really just a normal business?

options: Just like you're a normal engineer.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha... That's putting it simply.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Now that the Sarkaz are in charge of Londinium, who am I to doubt your excuses? You're security personnel working for a medical corporation, right?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's see... a team with a total of seventeen people. All of you are outfitted with military-grade equipment, and you work well with each other. You even have these half-decent drones.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: 'Half-decent...?'

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: What do you mean, 'half-decent?' You can't talk about my work like that!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Ehhh, settle down.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I didn't get a good look at them up there. Maybe you can show them to me another time?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: The Sarkaz blew them all up! Just thinking about it makes my heart ache!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Why don't you try fixing them? You should have a couple wrecked drones left, right? How about I take a look at them for you? I have all the tools we need.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Closure, I did manage to snatch two...

options: Those drones are Rhodes Island technology.
You have to work with us first before we can share it.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I gotta find something nice to trade with you, then?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Whoa, someone's cautious.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Doctor... What kind of doctor are you anyway? Eh, never mind. We'll talk about it another time. I'm in no rush.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That aside, how did you make it to Londinium in the first place? I've told you plenty about the city's situation. If we're working with each other, why don't you tell me something about the outside?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It was a long journey...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know you already fought Dublinn.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You have eyes outside the city?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Cautus lady. We talked about this. We're sharing information with each other.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Taking us back a bit... We did have a run-in with Dublinn outside Londinium...
